SELECT sales.date AS date, SUM(sales.orderCount) AS orderCount, SUM(sales.quantitySold) AS quantitySold, SUM(sales.productSalesAmount) AS productSalesAmount, SUM(sales.reservationCount) AS reservationCount, SUM(sales.concertSalesAmount) AS concertSalesAmount, SUM(sales.productSalesAmount) + SUM(sales.concertSalesAmount) AS totalSalesAmount FROM ( SELECT CAST(o.created_at AS DATE) AS date, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS quantitySold, COALESCE(SUM(oi.unit_price * oi.quantity), 0) AS productSalesAmount, 0 AS reservationCount, 0 AS concertSalesAmount FROM orders o JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN product p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE p.channel_id = #{channelId} AND o.created_at >= #{from} AND o.created_at < #{toExclusive} AND o.status != 'CANCELLED' GROUP BY CAST(o.created_at AS DATE)
UNION ALL
SELECT CAST(r.reserved_at AS DATE) AS date, 0 AS orderCount, 0 AS quantitySold, 0 AS productSalesAmount, COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS reservationCount, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(r.reserved_price, s.price)), 0) AS concertSalesAmount FROM reservation r JOIN seat s ON s.id = r.seat_id JOIN concert c ON c.id = r.concert_id WHERE c.channel_id = #{channelId} AND r.reserved_at >= #{from} AND r.reserved_at < #{toExclusive} AND r.status != 'CANCELLED' GROUP BY CAST(r.reserved_at AS DATE) ) sales GROUP BY sales.date ORDER BY date

SELECT p.id AS productId, p.name AS productName, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS quantitySold, COALESCE(SUM(oi.unit_price * oi.quantity), 0) AS salesAmount FROM orders o JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN product p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE p.channel_id = #{channelId} AND o.created_at >= #{from} AND o.created_at < #{toExclusive} AND o.status != 'CANCELLED' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY salesAmount DESC, p.id ASC

SELECT c.id AS concertId, c.title AS concertTitle, COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS reservationCount, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(r.reserved_price, s.price)), 0) AS salesAmount FROM reservation r JOIN concert c ON c.id = r.concert_id JOIN seat s ON s.id = r.seat_id WHERE c.channel_id = #{channelId} AND r.reserved_at >= #{from} AND r.reserved_at < #{toExclusive} AND r.status != 'CANCELLED' GROUP BY c.id, c.title ORDER BY salesAmount DESC, c.id ASC
SELECT channel_id FROM concert WHERE id = #{concertId}

SELECT s.grade AS grade, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS totalSeatCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.id IS NOT NULL THEN s.id END) AS reservedSeatCount, ROUND( 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.id IS NOT NULL THEN s.id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT s.id), 0), 2 ) AS reservationRate, COALESCE( SUM(CASE WHEN r.id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(r.reserved_price, s.price) ELSE 0 END), 0 ) AS salesAmount FROM seat s LEFT JOIN reservation r ON r.seat_id = s.id AND r.status != 'CANCELLED' WHERE s.concert_id = #{concertId} GROUP BY s.grade ORDER BY s.grade ASC
